einzeiler: How to navigate intimacy after finding out about a husband's hidden pornography use.
kurzfassung: A caller asks for advice on how to confront her husband about his hidden pornography use after discovering it through browser history. The host advises her to approach the conversation with honesty and vulnerability, focusing on the emotional disconnection and lack of pursuit rather than just the habit itself. He also emphasizes the importance of addressing broader marital dynamics and communication after welcoming a child.
stichpunkte: A caller seeks guidance on confronting her husband of two years about his secret pornography use.
The host suggests avoiding accusations and instead focusing on feelings of disconnection and being less wanted.
The discussion highlights the common psychological shifts in intimacy and roles after having a first child.
The host recommends using specific phrasing to express the stories built around the husband's lack of pursuit.
The importance of maintaining personal integrity and avoiding harsh judgments while uncovering the issue is emphasized.
The host advises setting aside dedicated, calm time for the conversation rather than bringing it up late at night.
The couple needs to redefine their roles, expectations around intimacy, and how they handle pursuit in this new life season.
